Data Scientist Mercedes Benz Research and Development India Full Time 08/2023 – Present

raw_sections.projects:
PROJECTS • Responsible AI SaaS Product (Mercedes Benz R & D India Project)
AI Ethics | Explainability | Fairness | MLOps Integration | API Development
Delivered an end-to-end Responsible AI framework addressing fairness, privacy,AI security and explainability across TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn models.
Developed APIs for seamless integration into MLOps pipelines (on-prem & cloud), supporting secure and compliant AI lifecycle workflows.
LLM-Govern: AI Compliance Assistant (Mercedes Benz R& D India Project)
Responsible AI | GDPR | RAG | LLAMA | LangChain
Engineered a compliance assistant for GDPR-aligned AI model evaluations using a fine-tuned LLAMA model with RAG. ◦ Built a web-based tool where developers input model/dataset metadata to receive compliance summaries and actionable guidance via Responsible AI tool links.
LexiQ-RAG: Legal Intelligence Assistant (Mercedes Benz R& D India Project)
LLM | RAG | LangChain | LLAMA 3 | Prompt Engineering
Built an Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using LLAMA 3 to streamline legal policy search across internal documents.
Designed conversational workflows with Chain-of-Thought prompting for interpretable reasoning. ◦ Integrated human-in-the-loop validation with legal experts and fine-tuned the model using proprietary legal corpora, significantly reducing manual legal consultations.
CompliCheck-RAG: Functional Compliance & Defeat Detectiont (Mercedes Benz R& D India Project)
RAG | GPT-4 | LangChain | PDF Parsing | JSON Structuring | Simulink Analysis
Developed an intelligent assistant to analyze ECU configurations from MATLAB-generated PDFs by converting diagrams into structured JSON.
Automated detection of defeat device behavior by mapping functional requirements to ECU parameters, delivering detailed compliance reports.
Enabled engineers to query functional flows, improving defect detection and regulatory alignment.
Real-Time Malware Detection at EV Charging Stations (Mercedes Benz R& D India Project)
Azure Databricks | PySpark | Power BI | Kafka | MLlib | Spark Streaming
Built a real-time malware anomaly detection pipeline using sensor data collected during EV charging. ◦ Processed streaming data using PySpark, stored results in Azure Data Lake, and visualized insights via Power BI dashboards.
Implemented ML models to detect and alert on malicious socket behavior, enhancing EV cybersecurity.
Secure Federated Learning Architecture (MTech Thesis)
Federated Learning | TensorFlow | Docker | Socket Programming | Privacy-Preserving AI
Proposed a privacy-preserved Federated Learning architecture to defend against poisoning and inference attacks. ◦ Implemented secure communication protocols and differential privacy techniques for decentralized model training across edge nodes.

ACHIEVEMENTS
o Winner of Mercedes Benz Intrapreneurship Award 2025.
o

Completed 1-year PG Diploma in Quantum Machine Learning from IIT Madras, specializing in the convergence of quantum computing and AI. Successfully selected in the prestigious Mercedes-Benz Intrapreneurship Program (MBIIP 2023), with our idea standing out as the only startup idea among 240 Proof of Concepts (POCs) in 2023 to progress to the startup stage. Filed 4 patents in Mercedes Benz R&D related to Responsible AI research, addressing key challenges in ethics, compliance, and transparency in AI systems. Played a pivotal role in the end-to-end development of the project, transforming it into a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) and positioning it as the second-ever startup to emerge from Mercedes-Benz India, following the first startup launched in 2021.
